film.title: The Truman Show
S: The guards watching want another slice

Oil a large baking tray and press the dough out to the edges. Spread with passata seasoned with the oregano and a pinch of salt. Scatter over the mozzarella and pepperoni, then the parmesan. Bake at 240C until the base is crisp and the cheese is blistered. Cut into squares and serve hot.
Fiji kokoda cups with coconut and lime
Truman still dreams of getting to Fiji

Toss the fish with the juice of 3 limes and a pinch of salt and chill until it turns white. Drain off most of the lime juice. Stir in the coconut cream, chilli, cucumber, tomato and spring onion. Spoon into the lettuce cups and finish with the last lime.
M: Boil the macaroni until just short of tender and drain. Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, then whisk in the milk until thick. Take off the heat and stir in the mustard, cheddar and half the gruyere. Fold through the pasta and ham and tip into a baking dish. Top with the rest of the gruyere and the panko and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling.
Truman sails into the painted sky

Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with 50g butter and the warm milk. Soften the leek in 60g butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Stir in the fish, prawns, dill and lemon zest and tip into a baking dish. Spread over the mash, rough up the top with a fork and bake at 200C until golden.
W: Meryl pitches Mococoa in the middle of a fight

Heat 300ml cream and the milk until steaming, then stir in the chocolate and cocoa until smooth. Whisk the yolks, sugar and vanilla, then whisk in the hot chocolate cream. Pour into 4 small cups in a deep tray, add hot water halfway up, and bake at 150C until just set with a wobble. Chill, then top with the rest of the cream, softly whipped.
K: Marlon holds the can right up to the camera
Chill the cans on ice until very cold. Hand them out with a straight face and the label facing the room.
film.D: An insurance man in a perfect seaside town slowly works out that his whole life is a TV show, and the town is a set.
film.P: Serve the Mococoa when Meryl starts selling it in the middle of a fight.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the mushrooms and make the dough the day before; top and bake to serve

steps.text: Roast the mushrooms with half the oil at 220C until golden.
Press the dough onto an oiled tray and spread with passata.
Top with mozzarella, mushrooms and parmesan and bake at 240C until crisp.
